deadline.value: Applications received on or before January 4 get first priority; later ones are considered on a space-available basis.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional; submit them only if you have taken the test.

supervisor.value: Applicants list up to three Biology faculty as potential research advisors on the online form.

funding.value: The page says PhD students are supported for up to five years but does not say all admitted students are funded.
